# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c35 P19](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0019)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds Harbor (the house by the harbour shore)  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jem  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>; Little Jem  <sub>[v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P10](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Jem is a tall, sturdy boy with curly red hair resembling his mother's and frank hazel eyes and a steady, humorous mouth like his father's. He has a fine nose and neat ears that meet Susan Baker's approval. His open brow and fearless expression give him a tall and splendid posture.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c35 P19](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0019)_

## Personality

Jem is a reliable, thoughtful, and pragmatic boy who is not a great talker. Driven by curiosity and a desire to learn from direct observation and scientific experiment, he will willingly endure physical discomfort to investigate the truth of a statement. He is a natural leader among his school peers, demonstrating dependable honesty by never breaking a promise.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)_

## Traits

- Sturdy and reliable  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Curious and experimental  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Truthful and keeps promises  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Observant  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Fearless  <sub>[v5 c35 P19](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0019)</sub>

## Abilities

- Mimicking the call of wild birds and beasts  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Locating wild flowers, berries, nuts, spruce-gum, and trouting spots  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Telling fortunes from daisy petals  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Outdoor outdoor cooking and fishing  <sub>[v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007)</sub>
- Grubbing up edible roots  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>

## Goals

- To investigate the truth of statements through direct experience and observation  <sub>[v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011)</sub>

## History

Jem was born at the little house of dreams by Four Winds Harbor, the eldest child of Anne and Gilbert Blythe, before his family moved to Ingleside in Glen St. Mary. As he grew up, he earned a reputation among his siblings and peers as a good, reliable student, a chieftain at school, and an expert explorer of the natural surroundings. On his eighth birthday, he successfully asked his mother to stop calling him 'Little Jem,' though he maintained a lighthearted feud with Susan Baker over the moniker. Jem spent much of his leisure time playing in Rainbow Valley with his siblings and the children from the Glen manse, often gathering wild mayflowers for his mother or cooking freshly caught trout over a campfire for his friends. On one evening in Rainbow Valley, after Walter spoke dreamily of the Pied Piper, Jem confidently stood up on a hillock and declared that he would gladly follow the Piper round the world.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P9](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0009), [v5 c3 P10](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0010), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014), [v5 c4 P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 c4 P44](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0044), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c4 P62](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0062), [v5 c35 P19](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0019), [v5 c35 P20](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0020)_
